arguments.content: P1 — Removing a legacy reader during a bounded schema migration can break the entire list operation even when all new writes use the new shape. In the destination reader cleanup, the two existing tests pass, but comparing HEAD against the staged reader on the supported mixed snapshot fails with KeyError('destination') at migration limits 0 and 1; limit 2 passes after every legacy row is migrated. Review removal against persisted mixed data and intermediate migration states; new-write round-trip tests do not establish that a compatibility reader is safe to delete.
